finals.text: {"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"e3dab4c9c24bb3ac77848fa2debb4a827a746c5bcb720829da5392bf1f4bb289","choices":[{"id":"87da8c37b16d810331a2","reason":"The acid has measured V2 values of 108.89 mL at 1/1 and 60.92 mL at 5/1 (f90a5a5a54509c085ebd, 1e775e7d8dcbf48fd6f8). Measuring 0/1 tests the unobserved strong-eluent end of this unusual response.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"9a32b65bc21fdc5f7286","reason":"At 2/1, the predicted V2 is 70.57 mL. This probes interpolation between the acid's measured 1/1 and 5/1 conditions; the different loading-solvent volume limits a clean condition comparison.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"9603a9567c8b21458d1e","reason":"The malonate's measured V1/V2 rise from 7.04/13.15 mL at 5/1 to 18.43/30.51 mL at 20/1 (f82f2844c7e27afd32bb, 3726956d81fe3954e5b7). The 10/1 measurement tests the predicted intermediate response.","hypothesis_id":"H2"},{"id":"4c2ad10692512e8f23b8","reason":"Only a 0/1 measurement exists for this trifluorinated diketone (14d7f6fb3dda38f48fb9). Its 20/1 prediction tests transfer across a large eluent change for a potentially tautomeric compound; that chemical effect remains untested.","hypothesis_id":"H3"},{"id":"0b9a59526d7d4ce5f872","reason":"Pairing 50/1 with the selected 20/1 condition tests whether the model's large predicted V1/V2 rise for the same trifluorinated diketone is real. The sole measured anchor is at 0/1 (14d7f6fb3dda38f48fb9).","hypothesis_id":"H3"},{"id":"45a1b11ae63f2dab2e48","reason":"This alcohol has no supplied measurement. Its 5/1 prediction gives a same-molecule anchor for the selected 10/1 condition, testing whether hydroxyl retention changes as predicted.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"73502a52708e4f9c2391","reason":"The predicted alcohol V1/V2 jump from 16.42/27.70 mL at 5/1 to 31.69/54.72 mL at 10/1 is large. Measuring both conditions tests this unobserved model response.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"33ffc69a253a89f15995","reason":"Quinoline has no supplied measurement. A 5/1 result provides an anchor for testing the model's unusual 5/1-to-10/1 V2 trend in this basic heteroaromatic molecule.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"9cd02352c2ed7a3e2321","reason":"For quinoline, predicted V2 falls from 27.42 mL at 5/1 to 25.70 mL at 10/1 while V1 rises. This same-molecule contrast checks a possible model blind spot; no measured quinoline trend is available.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"4e66505f5d66d4fe37b9","reason":"This boronate has measured V2 near 7–8 mL at 0/1 and 1/1 (96b9b370ade7a60366fa, cb79e57eb461a7dcc59a). The 20/1 result tests extrapolation to weaker eluent.","hypothesis_id":"H6"},{"id":"903811765ba61a8af2b7","reason":"Pairing 50/1 with the selected 20/1 boronate condition tests the predicted further V2 rise to 24.69 mL. Existing measurements cover only 0/1 and 1/1.","hypothesis_id":"H6"},{"id":"302e458c5ed2285ca328","reason":"Methyl anthranilate rose modestly from 4.62/11.86 mL at 2/1 to 5.22/13.75 mL at 5/1 (a2b3a77e1b5200f7c164, 9333d130f52d80332cf0). Its 50/1 prediction tests much longer-range extrapolation for an amino ester.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"b51a88b6dc4049704214","reason":"The pending CW batch includes the same aromatic nitrile at 20/1, but neither condition has a measured response yet. Selecting 50/1 creates a condition contrast once the batch is revealed; evidence for its predicted width is weak.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"810b16f35a3a86f451ce","reason":"A methoxy-substituted aromatic ester at 50/1 tests whether ester and ether functionality together follow the model's predicted 17.42/33.27 mL response. The supplied measurements do not establish this molecule's behavior.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"bed2f1430d0964e86fcb","reason":"This fluoroacetophenone gives a PE-loaded aromatic ketone case at 20/1, complementing the DCM-loaded ketones in the pending CW batch. Its specific response is unmeasured.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"90eea1593f255ed0107f","reason":"The pending CW batch includes this diketone at 50/1. Measuring 0/1 creates a broad same-molecule eluent contrast and tests the predicted shift from an early, narrow interval; both responses remain unmeasured.","hypothesis_id":"H2"}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"This carboxylic acid may have an unusually large and condition-sensitive V2 and elution width. The supplied 1/1 and 5/1 measurements establish a large difference, but the shape between and beyond them is untested.","supporting_observed_ids":["f90a5a5a54509c085ebd","1e775e7d8dcbf48fd6f8"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"What are its measured V1/V2 at 0/1 and 2/1 with the catalogued 1500 µL loading-solvent volume?"},{"id":"H2","content":"For some esters and diketones, reducing eluent strength may raise V1 and V2 substantially. This is supported locally for the malonate and benzyl benzoate, but transfer to the selected diketone is an inference.","supporting_observed_ids":["f82f2844c7e27afd32bb","3726956d81fe3954e5b7","7abb2cb83395e9b18de1","7b34ee010f42fdae95b5","704ba630f25fe7f20166"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does malonate at 10/1 lie between its measured endpoints, and how much does the selected diketone shift from 0/1 to its pending 50/1 condition?"},{"id":"H3","content":"The trifluorinated naphthyl diketone may respond strongly to weaker eluent. Its possible tautomerism is a chemical prior, while only its 0/1 V1/V2 is observed.","supporting_observed_ids":["14d7f6fb3dda38f48fb9"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Do measured 20/1 and 50/1 V1/V2 follow the predicted rise from the 0/1 anchor?"},{"id":"H4","content":"The alcohol's hydroxyl group could make its response to PE/EA changes difficult to generalize, but no measurement for this molecule is supplied.","supporting_observed_ids":[],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Is the predicted jump between 5/1 and 10/1 present in measured V1 and V2?"},{"id":"H5","content":"The model predicts a slight V2 decrease for quinoline from 5/1 to 10/1 despite a V1 increase. This is an untested model pattern, with no supplied quinoline measurement.","supporting_observed_ids":[],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does measured quinoline V2 decrease between 5/1 and 10/1?"},{"id":"H6","content":"The boronate has short measured elution intervals at 0/1 and 1/1; a substantial V2 increase at 20/1 and 50/1 is model extrapolation.","supporting_observed_ids":["96b9b370ade7a60366fa","cb79e57eb461a7dcc59a"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"How do its measured V1 and V2 change at 20/1 and 50/1?"},{"id":"H7","content":"Methyl anthranilate's V1 and V2 increased modestly from 2/1 to 5/1. A much larger 50/1 response is plausible from eluent strength but is untested for this amino ester.","supporting_observed_ids":["a2b3a77e1b5200f7c164","9333d130f52d80332cf0"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does its measured 50/1 response approach the model's predicted 26.50/55.02 mL?"}],"feedback_interpretation":""}

{"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"dcfc9e50fda77a25d525eba696cb02b4536a3e6df91d7cf0bd8b45258acea8d8","choices":[{"id":"53c1be5b96937954b9fa","reason":"The prior model underpredicted this alcohol at 5/1 and 10/1 (45a1b11ae63f2dab2e48, 73502a52708e4f9c2391). Measuring 2/1 tests where its steep retention rise begins; the 1/1 result is pending.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"07933c8c797c30bb0e8e","reason":"Quinoline measured much later at 5/1 and 10/1 than the prior model predicted (33ffc69a253a89f15995, 9cd02352c2ed7a3e2321). Its 2/1 condition probes the lower-ratio onset of that blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"5b445b457a8b897a2d6c","reason":"The prior model underpredicted this cyclopropyl β-keto ester at 20/1 by 27.74 mL in V1 and 38.74 mL in V2 (ffc70e28db22d1cc1f3f). The 10/1 result tests whether the error persists at stronger eluent.","hypothesis_id":"H9"},{"id":"b37608f8c4a8ee4b8696","reason":"This acid's measured V2 varies sharply across 0/1, 1/1, 2/1, and 5/1, and prior predictions missed both directions. Its 10/1 prediction of 99.83 mL tests another high-volume condition; loading-solvent volume differs among existing records.","hypothesis_id":"H1"},{"id":"10f01f359bc6067d009f","reason":"The enamine ester measured V2 of 109.68 mL at 20/1, 48.52 mL above its prior prediction (5d6d4ac0c1dfacbde53d). Measuring 5/1 tests the start of its predicted broad elution interval.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"a2f83665cfe821271b30","reason":"Pairing 10/1 with the selected 5/1 enamine ester and observed 20/1 result tests the model's steep predicted V2 progression. The 10/1 response remains unmeasured.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"810b065b0b86ff8c9aae","reason":"Severe underprediction for quinoline suggests a possible basic-heteroaromatic transfer issue (33ffc69a253a89f15995, 9cd02352c2ed7a3e2321). This phenylpyridine at 10/1 pairs with a pending 50/1 result; transfer across molecules is untested.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"2dbfdf9c2d5defd09f7a","reason":"A different oxygen-rich ester was strongly underpredicted at 5/1 (c6924324ddd95f249df6). This multifunctional ester at 2/1 tests whether that error extends beyond the measured molecule; evidence for transfer is weak.","hypothesis_id":"H12"},{"id":"b7fffd840d208b29776c","reason":"The prior model underpredicted this conjugated ketone at 50/1 by 19.01 mL in V1 and 36.63 mL in V2 (c9bef93a79964dc6ede1). Measuring 20/1 tests its condition trend.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"b514312eda7950cdcf1c","reason":"Nitroacetophenone showed a large prior V1 underprediction at 10/1 (9ae9c8b491a04e429a11). This nitrobenzophenone at 50/1 probes transfer to another nitro aromatic ketone, with substantial scaffold and condition differences.","hypothesis_id":"H10"},{"id":"7654254c03d9de79740f","reason":"Naphthyl acetophenone at 50/1 measured later than predicted (c2334ccf8e6788ac6ca2). A naphthaldehyde at the same ratio tests whether this extends to another naphthyl carbonyl; that transfer is unobserved.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"d824f03d11ae777a2d00","reason":"This methylenedioxy acetophenone tests an oxygenated aromatic ketone at 10/1. Prior aromatic-carbonyl errors vary in direction, so a new scaffold helps locate the boundary of that model behavior.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"9bc73e0c27d4d6b44abb","reason":"Methyl anthranilate at 50/1 measured 6.84/12.43 mL against a prior 26.50/55.02 mL prediction (302e458c5ed2285ca328). This para-amino ethyl benzoate tests transfer to a related amino ester; position, ester group, and loading volume also differ.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"f17690c586ce5d166eb0","reason":"The same naphthyl acetate has a pending 50/1 measurement. Selecting 2/1 provides a wide same-molecule eluent contrast for an ester, where prior condition responses have proved molecule-specific.","hypothesis_id":"H2"},{"id":"ff9bcaab8e95f60d70bc","reason":"Naphthyl acetophenone measured 38.80/67.99 mL at 50/1, later than its prior prediction (c2334ccf8e6788ac6ca2). Its 20/1 result tests whether aromatic-ketone underprediction spans ratios.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"65f6e8326897810ec715","reason":"Nitroacetophenone at 10/1 measured 28.69/54.81 mL (9ae9c8b491a04e429a11). The 5/1 result tests its condition curve and whether the updated lower-ratio prediction remains too early.","hypothesis_id":"H10"}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"The cinnamic acid has highly condition-sensitive V2, including a 1/1 peak in the supplied measurements. The earlier simple interpolation idea is weakened: 0/1 measured 31.91 mL versus a prior prediction of 19.89 mL, while 2/1 measured 46.22 mL versus 70.57 mL predicted. Loading-solvent volume differs across some ratios.","supporting_observed_ids":["87da8c37b16d810331a2","f90a5a5a54509c085ebd","9a32b65bc21fdc5f7286","1e775e7d8dcbf48fd6f8"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"At the catalogued 1500 µL loading-solvent volume, does 10/1 produce another large V2 and elution interval?"},{"id":"H2","content":"Eluent-ratio trends are molecule-specific. Malonate V1/V2 rose across 5/1, 10/1, and 20/1, whereas dibenzoylmethane V1 changed little from 0/1 to 50/1 even as V2 increased. This narrows the earlier general ester-and-diketone trend hypothesis.","supporting_observed_ids":["f82f2844c7e27afd32bb","9603a9567c8b21458d1e","3726956d81fe3954e5b7","90eea1593f255ed0107f","8db24ae10df4095ada47"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"How does the naphthyl acetate shift between its selected 2/1 and pending 50/1 conditions?"},{"id":"H3","content":"The earlier predicted large 20/1-to-50/1 rise for the trifluorinated diketone was contradicted: measured V1 stayed near 5 mL and V2 near 32 mL at both ratios. Possible tautomerism remains a chemical prior, not an established cause.","supporting_observed_ids":["14d7f6fb3dda38f48fb9","4c2ad10692512e8f23b8","0b9a59526d7d4ce5f872"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["0b9a59526d7d4ce5f872"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Do other β-diketones also show a high-ratio V1 plateau with V2 changes?"},{"id":"H4","content":"The alcohol's measured V1/V2 rose from 34.58/50.00 mL at 5/1 to 51.71/94.93 mL at 10/1, with substantial prior underprediction at both. The differing V/ul values limit isolation of the ratio effect.","supporting_observed_ids":["45a1b11ae63f2dab2e48","73502a52708e4f9c2391"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does its 2/1 measurement already show late elution, and how does it compare with the pending 1/1 result?"},{"id":"H5","content":"The prior model severely underpredicted quinoline at 5/1 and 10/1, and its predicted V2 decrease between those ratios was contradicted by a measured rise from 57.67 to 93.07 mL. Transfer to other basic heteroaromatics is an inference.","supporting_observed_ids":["33ffc69a253a89f15995","9cd02352c2ed7a3e2321"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["9cd02352c2ed7a3e2321"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Where does quinoline's retention rise begin, and does phenylpyridine show a related effect?"},{"id":"H6","content":"The boronate remained relatively early at 20/1 and 50/1. Prior V2 predictions overestimated both measurements, weakening the earlier large-rise hypothesis.","supporting_observed_ids":["96b9b370ade7a60366fa","cb79e57eb461a7dcc59a","4e66505f5d66d4fe37b9","903811765ba61a8af2b7"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["4e66505f5d66d4fe37b9","903811765ba61a8af2b7"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does this relatively short interval persist for other boronates at weak eluent?"},{"id":"H7","content":"Methyl anthranilate's measured 50/1 V1/V2 of 6.84/12.43 mL sharply contradicted the prior model's 26.50/55.02 mL extrapolation. Its V2 did not grow beyond the measured 5/1 value; whether this transfers to other amino esters is unknown.","supporting_observed_ids":["a2b3a77e1b5200f7c164","9333d130f52d80332cf0","302e458c5ed2285ca328"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["302e458c5ed2285ca328"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does the related para-amino ethyl benzoate also elute earlier than predicted?"},{"id":"H8","content":"The enamine ester has an exceptionally wide measured interval at 20/1: 109.68 minus 29.26 mL. The prior model substantially underpredicted V2, while its lower-ratio response remains unobserved.","supporting_observed_ids":["5d6d4ac0c1dfacbde53d"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"How do its measured V1, V2, and interval width change at 5/1 and 10/1?"},{"id":"H9","content":"The prior model substantially underpredicted this cyclopropyl β-keto ester at 20/1. Whether the same error persists at 10/1 is untested.","supporting_observed_ids":["ffc70e28db22d1cc1f3f"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Is its 10/1 measurement also much later than the current prediction?"},{"id":"H10","content":"Nitroacetophenone at 10/1 measured much later in V1 than the prior model predicted. Transfer across eluent ratios and to nitrobenzophenone is untested.","supporting_observed_ids":["9ae9c8b491a04e429a11"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"What are nitroacetophenone's 5/1 V1/V2, and does nitrobenzophenone show a related discrepancy?"},{"id":"H11","content":"Several conjugated or fused aromatic carbonyls measured later than prior predictions, including naphthyl acetophenone and dibenzalacetone. Other aromatic ketones did not show the same direction, so this remains a limited scaffold pattern.","supporting_observed_ids":["c2334ccf8e6788ac6ca2","c9bef93a79964dc6ede1","0c5c35afb3a24375c153"],"contradicting_observed_ids":["9f362bfe1dab6e9eac3d"],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Do 20/1 measurements of the selected conjugated and naphthyl ketones preserve the large prior errors?"},{"id":"H12","content":"A methoxyethyl acetoacetate had much later measured V1/V2 than predicted at 5/1. Extending this to another oxygen-rich multifunctional ester is a weak, untested inference.","supporting_observed_ids":["c6924324ddd95f249df6"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"weak","next_discriminating_question":"Does the selected multifunctional ester at 2/1 also elute later than predicted?"}],"feedback_interpretation":"Round-zero feedback redirected the search toward measured prior-model failures: strong underprediction for quinoline, the alcohol, enamine ester, cyclopropyl β-keto ester, and several aromatic carbonyls; strong overprediction for methyl anthranilate and the high-ratio trifluorinated diketone; and opposite-direction V2 errors for the acid at 0/1 and 2/1. I selected lower-ratio contrasts and related scaffolds to test where those errors begin and whether they transfer, while retaining the earlier hypotheses with narrower assessments."}

{"type":"selection","packet_sha256":"49cd05a5a4cddcc9fc743b50d9586cc23af87a68de3878a7e19cab964b6c9604","choices":[{"id":"a1809a6c4c3ada20bcb0","reason":"This β-keto ester measured 19.45/45.11 mL at 10/1 and 44.45/81.20 mL at 20/1 (5b445b457a8b897a2d6c, ffc70e28db22d1cc1f3f). A 5/1 result locates the start of the steep rise; V/ul differs among records.","hypothesis_id":"H9"},{"id":"3f6b817d855e67b3b406","reason":"The conjugated ketone measured 13.35/35.72 mL at 20/1 and 28.20/68.68 mL at 50/1 (b7fffd840d208b29776c, c9bef93a79964dc6ede1). Its unexpectedly high 1/1 prediction, 28.51/66.26 mL, tests a possible model condition blind spot.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"7726f4a207a737256a86","reason":"For that same ketone, the 10/1 prediction is 5.91/18.30 mL. Measuring it alongside the selected 1/1 condition and observed 20/1 result tests the model's nonmonotone lower-ratio curve.","hypothesis_id":"H11"},{"id":"434e465cfa7e0034f233","reason":"Phenylpyridine measured 15.66/32.11 mL at 10/1 and 26.27/81.78 mL at 50/1 (810b065b0b86ff8c9aae, 35f2be5f5aa14265e8a4). The 20/1 measurement tests where its V2 and interval width expand.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"8e7636d7a60a6058305a","reason":"The enamine ester measured 29.26/109.68 mL at 20/1 with DCM loading (5d6d4ac0c1dfacbde53d). This PE-loaded 20/1 case tests transfer across loading conditions, though V/ul and loading volume also change.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"71f5df8c7d7e88d1afce","reason":"The enamine ester's measured V2 climbs from 36.80 to 60.45 to 109.68 mL across 5/1, 10/1, and 20/1 (10f01f359bc6067d009f, a2f83665cfe821271b30, 5d6d4ac0c1dfacbde53d). A 0/1 result tests its strong-eluent endpoint.","hypothesis_id":"H8"},{"id":"aa43fe84c0d8c825fe58","reason":"Nitrobenzophenone at 50/1 measured V1 4.49 mL and V2 81.30 mL, an unusually wide interval (b514312eda7950cdcf1c). A 20/1 result, with 10/1 pending, tests how that interval develops.","hypothesis_id":"H10"},{"id":"70593725787c65a74951","reason":"Para-amino ethyl benzoate measured 26.80/57.07 mL at 5/1, far later than its prior prediction (9bc73e0c27d4d6b44abb). The predicted 11.00/20.49 mL at 2/1 tests whether the change is steep.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"cdf40bcb3f4392f8d7d1","reason":"Phenylpropanol rose sharply between measured 2/1 and 5/1 conditions (53c1be5b96937954b9fa, 45a1b11ae63f2dab2e48). Naphthylmethanol at 5/1 tests transfer to another aromatic alcohol; molecular and loading conditions differ.","hypothesis_id":"H4"},{"id":"537a64f15ea470d73b03","reason":"A para-amino ester measured much later than predicted at 5/1 (9bc73e0c27d4d6b44abb). This aminobenzonitrile at 1/1 pairs with a pending 5/1 result to test whether the polar amino scaffold has a similarly steep response; transfer is uncertain.","hypothesis_id":"H7"},{"id":"3cd0aa35793392d15513","reason":"Naphthyl acetate measured 5.23/13.28 mL at 2/1 and 30.46/50.78 mL at 50/1 (f17690c586ce5d166eb0, c80022254967f6a925f3). The 20/1 measurement tests the interpolation and earlier high-ratio underprediction.","hypothesis_id":"H2"},{"id":"4fce6e1a422b4f54c601","reason":"This trifluoromethoxy phenol at 2/1 pairs with a pending 5/1 result. It tests a same-molecule hydroxyl-containing condition contrast; there is no supplied measurement for this molecule yet.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"855832bd4005ac7abdc6","reason":"Ethyl nicotinate measured 41.71/106.06 mL at 10/1, far above the prior prediction (c76d0420b34df595c0c9). Its 5/1 result tests whether substantial late elution begins before 10/1.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"6f827d26c4f82a1bfa90","reason":"Pairing this nicotinate at 1/1 with the selected 5/1 condition and observed 10/1 endpoint brackets its response across eluent strength. The current 1/1 prediction remains untested.","hypothesis_id":"H5"},{"id":"4ec77f604fa08f281ef7","reason":"This acyclic aldehyde measured 27.76/69.61 mL at 50/1 (0d588f7534b7a34cb10a). Its 10/1 prediction of 10.16/18.26 mL tests a large condition shift for a scaffold with little supplied coverage.","hypothesis_id":null},{"id":"77aca3cfa4edafa6e181","reason":"The bromo acid's recorded 50/1 V2 is −0.10 mL, below V1 of 0.13 mL (129036e0bccc4ff7e848). A 1/1 measurement checks whether this anomalous endpoint is isolated; the record does not support a chemical explanation.","hypothesis_id":"H13"}],"hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","content":"Cinnamic acid retains highly condition-sensitive V2: the new 10/1 measurement is 91.31 mL after 46.22 mL at 2/1 and 60.92 mL at 5/1. The earlier simple interpolation hypothesis remains inadequate; loading-solvent volume differs across some records.","supporting_observed_ids":["87da8c37b16d810331a2","f90a5a5a54509c085ebd","9a32b65bc21fdc5f7286","1e775e7d8dcbf48fd6f8","b37608f8c4a8ee4b8696"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"How much of the unusual V2 pattern is attributable to eluent ratio versus loading-solvent volume?"},{"id":"H2","content":"Eluent-ratio response is strongly molecule-specific. Naphthyl acetate rose from 5.23/13.28 mL at 2/1 to 30.46/50.78 mL at 50/1, while the earlier β-diketone showed much less V1 change. A 20/1 measurement can test the acetate's intermediate response.","supporting_observed_ids":["f17690c586ce5d166eb0","c80022254967f6a925f3","90eea1593f255ed0107f","8db24ae10df4095ada47"],"contradicting_observed_ids":[],"evidence_strength":"moderate","next_discriminating_question":"Does naphthyl acetate at 20/1 fall between its measured 2/1 and 50/1 V1/V2 endpoints?"},{"id":"H4","content":"Phenylpropanol measured 8.57/16.45 mL at 1/1, 13.06/22.22 mL at 2/1, 34.58/50.00 mL at 5/1, and 51.71/94.93 mL at 10/1.
